subject: FT.CREATE consistency check (#386)
reason: The only behavioural change sits behind the coordinator, which this fuzzer cannot enable. FT.CREATE's new consistency-check fanout runs only when `ValkeySearch::Instance().IsCluster() && UsingCoordinator()` (src/commands/ft_create.cc:63-70); otherwise the command takes the unchanged else-branch and replies OK exactly as the parent build does. UsingCoordinator() is true only when the coordinator gRPC server was created at module load, which requires the `--use-coordinator` module startup argument: it is a Hidden config, never registered with Valkey, so it cannot be set by `CONFIG SET` or a `sea
